# appropriate

> Set aside or authorize (such as money) for a particular purpose; take for one's own use

> to allocate.

> 1. take something forcefully, usually without the owner's agreement
> 2. suitable or fit for a situation


## Example

- *The government appropriated land that was occupied by squatters, sending them scurrying for another place to live. This word has other definitions but this is the most important one for the GRE.*
